document.title: Appendix A: Material Table
document.description: Density and Z-Ratio for various materials, listed alphabetically by chemical formula. Z-Ratio values are normalized for AT-cut quartz crystals.
warnings: Some of these materials are hazardous. Consult the material safety data sheet and safety instructions before use.
An asterisk (*) indicates that a Z-Ratio has not been established for a certain material; a value of 1.000 is defaulted in these situations.

column_definitions.material_name_zh: Chinese material name (added for the Zevision process editor)
column_definitions.z_ratio_established: false when the manual shows * (no established Z-Ratio; defaulted to 1.000)
